about.title: About Clavis
about.p1: Clavis helps students from Turkmenistan and their parents find universities abroad that the Ministry of Education recognises, the bachelor's programs, foundation and language years they offer, and the scholarships that pay for them.
about.p2: Programs are at the centre. A foundation or language year is one step of a path to a bachelor's, and Clavis shows the total years of each path as a plain fact.
about.p3: Clavis is free. It has no ads, and your data is never sold or shared.
about.p4: Clavis is in Turkmen, Russian and English, on the web and as a Telegram Mini App.
howWeCheck.title: How we check
howWeCheck.intro: Every university, program and scholarship on Clavis shows when we last checked it and the source we checked it against.
howWeCheck.ministry.title: Ministry status
howWeCheck.ministry.body: We compare each university with the Ministry of Education of Turkmenistan's list of recognised foreign universities. The list names the ranking and position that qualify a university; we show that as the basis.
howWeCheck.facts.title: Costs, deadlines and requirements
howWeCheck.facts.body: We take tuition, deadlines and requirements from the official pages of the university or scholarship. When we can't confirm something, we say so, for example "Cost not confirmed", instead of guessing.
howWeCheck.money.body: Costs are in US dollars. The amount in manat uses the rate and date shown beside it.
howWeCheck.mistakes.title: Found a mistake?
howWeCheck.mistakes.body: Every record has a "Report a mistake" link. We read each report and correct the record.
howWeCheck.official: Always check the official page before you apply.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: You can use Clavis without an account. It has no ads and no trackers, and loads no third-party scripts.
privacy.account.title: If you create an account
privacy.account.body: We store a display name, how you sign in (Telegram, email or Google), your language, your saved items and your application tracker. We don't ask for your age, real name or phone number.
privacy.messages.title: Emails and messages
privacy.messages.body: We only send sign-in codes and the deadline reminders you choose.
privacy.device.title: On your device
privacy.device.body: Your language choice is kept in a cookie. Your Compare picks are kept in your browser's storage.
privacy.reports.title: Reports
privacy.reports.body: When you report a mistake, we store your message and the record it is about, not who sent it.
privacy.control.title: Your choice
privacy.control.body: You can delete your account and all its data from your Profile at any time. We never sell or share your data.
